title.narrative: Athar for Training Services/Upper Egypt Green Boost
Athar for Training Services/Upper Egypt Green Boost

description.narrative: Upper Egypt Green Boost is a project designed to help solve local climate change issues through entrepreneurship. The project aims to create change through 4 main areas: 1) A manifesto to be published and act as a roadmap to green challenges and opportunities in Upper Egypt, which aims to provide a guide to all social entrepreneurs who want to solve Upper Egypt green challenges in different green sectors. 2) A green cluster to be formed of key actors in the green ecosystem, and act as a tool for facilitating access to network for both Intermediate organizations and MSMEs. 3) Two hackathons to be organized as a catalyst for generating new MSMEs & startups, where social entrepreneurs can gather and work together with talents to solve local green challenges. 4) Two acceleration rounds to be organized, and act as a long-term program for providing structural support to startups and MSMEs to increase their odds of success.
